title: Our story
slide_intent: Ground the institution in place and community so a writer can explain what connects its venues.
strategic_value: The story can associate Sheffield Museums with the people, landscape and history of Sheffield while giving its portfolio a common purpose.
demonstration: Two narrow columns describe the venues’ place in Sheffield and the region, their relationships with communities and their ambition to connect the past with the future.
practical_value: Use the account of local roots and collaboration when introducing the institution to visitors or partners.
